other.name: Outgoing email
other.needs: An email address and its SMTP login (e.g. Google Workspace / Microsoft 365 app password). Desk → Email Account.
other.what: Sends notifications and reminders by email (in-app notifications already work).

other.name: Meta Lead Ads (lead forms)
other.needs: Admin access to the Facebook Page and the lead forms; connect in the CRM (/crm → Settings → Facebook). Decided for later (D-026).
other.what: Leads from Facebook/Instagram lead forms go straight into Sales.

other.approval: Meta must verify the business and approve message templates.
other.name: WhatsApp
other.needs: A WhatsApp Business API number through Meta (Cloud API) or a provider; a verified Meta Business account. Decided for later (D-026).
other.what: Chat with leads and customers from the CRM.

other.name: Website lead form
other.needs: A form ID and key from Sales → Setup → Website forms, and a few lines added to the website form (your web developer).
other.what: Enquiries from your website create leads automatically.

other.name: Server and web address
other.needs: A server (about $20–60/month) and a web address such as ops.yourdomain.com. Your approval for the cost.
other.what: Lets your team use the system and lets every sync and reminder run on its own.

other.name: Email support (Helpdesk)
other.needs: Frappe Helpdesk app + a support email inbox. Decided for later (D-034).
other.what: Customer emails become tickets; a customer portal.

other.name: AI provider (Phase 5)
other.needs: An AI provider account and your approval for its monthly cost.
